entry_points.text: File read rejects disconnected guest, zero on host loss when empty, EAGAIN for nonblocking empty, sleeps freezably then delivers; write caps at 32 KiB, stages and submits; splice rejects serial and submits one mapping; poll reports readable, writable and hangup; async forwards to per-port queue.
Console output returns full count on unplug or freeze, else stages and submits blocking; console input requires queue and uses shared kernel read.

exports.text: Outbound helper submits one segment with token; broken probe reports cached failure atomically.
Sixteen and thirty-two bit conversions select endian per device order both ways; control carries u32 id plus u16 event and value in device endian.

Creation lazily inits, allocates object, picks index by match, free or overflow and links; removal detaches, drops ref and hangs up; indexing reuses matching slot, else free, else overflow updating shared tables only for static slots.
Kick wakes worker, poll reports pending work without sleep, resize stores size and schedules propagation under lock.
Driver alloc binds module and records ops; ref release is no-op, throttled reads flag; flip insert has fast path with position helpers.
Registration checks list linkage under console guard; lock validation is empty.

hazards.text: Control and blocking transmit spin until completion or broken, requiring no sleeping locks; recycle, control and console output use atomic alloc under spinlocks while write and splice allocate sleepably after waiting.
Unknown or out-of-range host ids never create state and drop with diagnostics; name or attribute failure leaves port functional without naming.
Unplug nulls link under output lock fencing transmit and close; vanished completions discard with only buffer release.

invariants.text: Presence refreshes cached input under guard; read copies remainder and recycles; discard drains counting bytes; read blocks only with no data while connected; write follows full flag, free after guest loss, blocked without host.

Transmit samples link under output guard, aborts on unplug or freeze, reclaims, submits scatter set, sets full on exhaustion and optionally spins; failures release buffer; pipe mapping steals or copies pages.

Control send skips single-port devices; otherwise serializes packet and queue, fills converted id, event and value, submits once, notifies and polls unless broken; per-port forward skips when link cleared.

New ports start disconnected with cleared stats, zero geometry and bound queues; creation precedes priming and publication and unwinds in reverse signalling unready on failure; priming adds page buffers until saturation, aborts on exhaustion releasing tentative buffer while full during creation is benign; geometry touches only console ports.

Host messages drive create, remove, promotion, geometry, presence and naming; duplicates reaffirm ready, promotion completes boot, naming is one-time; unknown ids drop and oversized warns; receive keeps console and serial, drops unconnected generic, signals async and wakes; control work bounds lengths, recycles and drops lock while dispatching; completions wake and drop refs; unknown queues drain; teardown discards receive and reclaims transmit.

HVC setup overprovisions with hvc identity, starts worker before registration, publishes after barrier and unwinds in reverse propagating errors; transmit preserves unwritten bytes; polling skips throttled or unattached, hangs up on disconnect, defers on retry or exhaustion and splits large reads with deferred continuation; console registers only for matching index.

Console setup allocates terminal number, creates page-sized console, links under driver guard, sets guest flag and announces open; add marks irq and tries resize while remove and hangup clear it; non-console skips resize.

locks.text: Input guard irq-saved covers cached input, flags, presence, read recycle, open, release, discard, teardown and async.
Output guard irq-saved covers submission, full flag, link sampling and freeze check, plus reclamation during writability, open, release and unplug.
Control guard serializes packet build, submit and poll; control work holds queue lock only to fetch or return buffers.
Device lock covers list insert and unplug detach; queue lock covers only enqueue; driver lock covers console link; console data lock covers detach.
HVC instance lock covers drain and poll with drops for schedule, hangup and delivery; global mutex covers tables; list guard covers registration.

state_machines.text: Open rejects missing, console or busy, else sets guest flag, reclaims and announces open; release announces close, clears flag, discards, reclaims and drops ref; ports go allocation, creation, publication and ready to operation, then unplug to detach, reclaim, destroy and free; presence follows messages, serial defaults true, guest clears on unplug; either wakes waiters.
Poll reports write pending with output and read pending with available, throttled, backlogged or truncated input; activity resets timing while stall extends delay.

structs.text: Splice staging tracks used, capacity, bytes and array; TTY chars start at base plus offset with flags one capacity beyond; file table binds open, read, write, splice, poll, release and async; console ops bind input, output, add, remove and hangup.

Port state holds ids, queues, handles, locks, waitqueue, flags, counters and geometry; named ports expose one newline name with change event; diagnostics give identity, connectivity, saturation and counters; vport minor equals id.
Resize has cols then rows as u16; open uses PORT_OPEN 1 for open and 0 for close plus SIZE; host signals add, remove, ready, console, geometry, presence, naming with 1 ready and 0 failure.
